source.text: וַ֭יַּעַן צֹפַ֥ר הַנַּֽעֲמָתִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

en.B: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered:
en.R: Then Zophar the Naamathite said:

es.B: Entonces Zofar el naamatita respondió:
es.R: Entonces Zofar el naamatita dijo:

fr.L: Et Tsophar le Naamatite répondit et dit :
fr.B: Alors Tsophar le Naamatite répondit :
fr.R: Alors Tsophar le Naamatite a dit :

sw.L: Ndipo Sofari Mnaamathi akajibu, akasema:
sw.B: Kisha Sofari Mnaamathi akajibu:
sw.R: Kisha Sofari Mnaamathi akasema:

vi.L: Sô-pha người Na-a-ma đáp lời và nói:
vi.B: Bấy giờ Sô-pha người Na-a-ma đáp:
vi.R: Sô-pha người Na-a-ma nói:

ko.L: 그러자 나아마 사람 소발이 대답하여 말했다.
ko.B: 그러자 나아마 사람 소발이 대답했다.
ko.R: 그러자 나아마 사람 소발이 말했다.

decisions.choice: Zophar the Naamathite: the third of Job's friends
decisions.reason: Zophar was introduced in 2:11 and first spoke in chapter 11. This is his second speech and, as the text stands, his last: he has no third speech after chapter 26. "Naamathite" names his people or home, which is not known for certain.

decisions.choice: answered and said: the usual opening of a speech
decisions.reason: "He answered and said" introduces each speech in the dialogue (4:1; 8:1; 11:1). Zophar answers Job's speech in chapter 19.

decisions.choice: answered / said
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use one English verb for the Hebrew pair, the book's pattern for speech introductions. The introduction stays prose.

decisions.choice: "répondit" (Literal, Balanced), "a dit" (Readable) in the speech introduction
decisions.reason: The introduction is narrative: passé simple at Literal and Balanced, passé composé at Readable, as for all narrative in these books. Zophar's speech itself is speech and uses the present, future and passé composé at every level.

source.text: לָ֭כֵן שְׂעִפַּ֣י יְשִׁיב֑וּנִי וּ֝בַעֲב֗וּר ח֣וּשִׁי בִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore my disquieting thoughts make me answer, and because of my agitation in me.

en.L: Therefore my troubled thoughts make me answer, \q because of the agitation within me.
en.B: So my troubled thoughts urge me to reply, \q because I am deeply stirred.
en.R: My troubled thoughts make me answer you, \q because I am so upset inside.

es.L: Por eso mis pensamientos inquietos me hacen responder, \q a causa de la agitación [que hay] en mí.
es.B: Por eso mis pensamientos turbados me impulsan a replicar, \q porque estoy profundamente agitado.
es.R: Mis pensamientos inquietos me obligan a responderte, \q porque estoy muy alterado por dentro.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi mes pensées inquiètes me font répondre, \q à cause de l’agitation [qui est] en moi.
fr.B: Aussi mes pensées troublées me poussent-elles à répliquer, \q car je suis profondément remué.
fr.R: Mes pensées agitées m’obligent à te répondre, \q parce que je suis bouleversé au fond de moi.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo mawazo yangu yanayonisumbua yananifanya nijibu, \q kwa sababu ya msukosuko ulio ndani yangu.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo mawazo yangu yanayonihangaisha yananisukuma nijibu, \q kwa maana nimechochewa sana moyoni.
sw.R: Mawazo yangu yanayonisumbua yananilazimisha nikujibu, \q kwa sababu nimefadhaika sana ndani yangu.

vi.L: Vì vậy những ý nghĩ bối rối của tôi khiến tôi phải đáp lại, \q vì sự xao động ở trong tôi.
vi.B: Cho nên những ý nghĩ rối bời thúc giục tôi đáp lời, \q vì lòng tôi xao động mạnh mẽ.
vi.R: Những ý nghĩ rối bời khiến tôi phải trả lời anh, \q vì trong lòng tôi đang rất bực bội.

ko.L: 그러므로 나의 어지러운 생각들이 나로 대답하게 하니, \q 내 속에서 일어나는 동요 때문이오.
ko.B: 그래서 내 어지러운 생각들이 대답하라고 나를 재촉하오. \q 내 마음이 몹시 들끓기 때문이오.
ko.R: 생각이 어지러워서 그대에게 대답하지 않을 수 없소. \q 속이 몹시 상했기 때문이오.

decisions.choice: troubled thoughts: anxious, disquieting thoughts
decisions.reason: The word (se'ippim) means thoughts that trouble and divide the mind. Eliphaz used it of the night thoughts in which a vision came to him (4:13).

decisions.choice: my agitation: the inner stir that hurries him to speak
decisions.reason: The verb (chush) means to hurry or to be stirred up. Zophar feels pressed to answer at once.

decisions.choice: therefore: a reply to Job's last words
decisions.reason: "Therefore" ties Zophar's reply to what Job has just said, above all his warning that the friends themselves should fear the sword of judgment (19:28-29).

decisions.choice: So ... deeply stirred / so upset inside
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the abstract noun into a plain clause about how Zophar feels.

decisions.choice: 하오체 (-오, -소) with "그대" and "나" in the lines Zophar addresses to Job (verses 2-4; verse 5 at Literal and Balanced, which completes "you know"); his poem on the fate of the wicked (verses 5-29) in plain 해라체 (-다, -느냐)
decisions.reason: Job and his friends speak to each other as equals of standing, in 하오체 with "그대", in the lines one addresses to the other. The portrait of the wicked does not address Job, and Korean poetry states it in the plain written style, as Bildad's poem (18:5-21) and Eliphaz's (15:20-35) are; God keeps -시-.

source.text: מוּסַ֣ר כְּלִמָּתִ֣י אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וְ֝ר֗וּחַ מִֽבִּינָתִ֥י יַעֲנֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] correction of my insult I hear, and a spirit from my understanding answers me.

en.L: I hear a rebuke that insults me, \q and a spirit from my understanding answers me.
en.B: I have heard a rebuke that insults me, \q and out of my understanding my spirit gives me a reply.
en.R: I have heard you scold me, and it insults me. \q But my spirit understands and tells me what to answer.

es.L: Oigo una reprensión que me afrenta, \q y un espíritu [que sale] de mi entendimiento me responde.
es.B: He oído una reprensión que me ofende, \q y desde mi entendimiento mi espíritu me da respuesta.
es.R: Te he oído regañarme, y eso me ofende. \q Pero mi espíritu entiende y me dice qué responder.

fr.L: J’entends une réprimande qui m’outrage, \q et un esprit [venu] de mon intelligence me répond.
fr.B: J’ai entendu une réprimande qui m’outrage, \q et du fond de mon intelligence mon esprit me fournit une réponse.
fr.R: Je t’ai entendu me faire des reproches, et cela m’a blessé. \q Mais mon esprit comprend et me dit quoi répondre.

sw.L: Nasikia karipio linalonitukana, \q na roho itokayo katika ufahamu wangu inanijibu.
sw.B: Nimesikia karipio linalonivunjia heshima, \q na kutoka katika ufahamu wangu roho yangu inanipa jibu.
sw.R: Nimekusikia ukinikemea, nami nimeona ni matusi. \q Lakini roho yangu inaelewa na inaniambia la kujibu.

vi.L: Tôi nghe lời quở trách làm tôi nhục nhã, \q và một tâm linh từ sự hiểu biết của tôi đáp lời tôi.
vi.B: Tôi đã nghe lời khiển trách sỉ nhục tôi, \q và từ sự hiểu biết của mình, tâm linh tôi cho tôi lời đáp.
vi.R: Tôi đã nghe anh mắng tôi, và điều đó xúc phạm tôi. \q Nhưng tâm linh tôi hiểu rõ và cho tôi biết phải trả lời thế nào.

ko.L: 나를 모욕하는 책망을 내가 듣소. \q 그러나 내 깨달음에서 나온 영이 내게 대답하오.
ko.B: 나를 모욕하는 책망을 내가 들었소. \q 그러나 내 깨달음에서 내 영이 나에게 대답을 주오.
ko.R: 그대가 나를 꾸짖는 말을 들으니 모욕을 당한 것 같소. \q 그러나 내 영이 깨달아 무엇이라 대답할지 일러 주오.

decisions.choice: a rebuke that insults me: a correction that shames me
decisions.reason: Musar is correction or discipline; kelimmah is disgrace. Zophar takes Job's words in 19:2-6 and 19:28-29 as a rebuke that puts him to shame.

decisions.choice: a spirit from my understanding: Zophar's own inner spirit, prompted by what he understands
alternatives: a spirit beyond my understanding answers me
decisions.reason: Ruach here is the human spirit, the inner self that moves a person to speak (32:18). The preposition "from" can also mean "beyond", which would make it an outside spirit inspiring him, as Eliphaz claimed a spirit spoke to him (4:15); "from my understanding" fits the parallel with his own thoughts in verse 2.

decisions.choice: my spirit
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "my spirit" to make clear it is Zophar's own (m2).

decisions.choice: "tâm linh" for Zophar's spirit (ruach)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision takes the spirit as Zophar's own inner self; "tâm linh" is the human spirit, while "thần linh" would suggest an outside spirit speaking to him.

source.text: הֲזֹ֣את יָ֭דַעְתָּ מִנִּי־עַ֑ד מִנִּ֤י שִׂ֖ים אָדָ֣ם עֲלֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Do you know this from antiquity, from [when one] placed humankind on earth,

en.L: Do you know this from of old, \q since humankind was placed on [the] earth,
en.B: Surely you know how it has been from of old, \q ever since humans were placed on the earth,
en.R: Surely you know what has been true since long ago, \q ever since God put people on the earth:

es.L: ¿Sabes esto desde antiguo, \q desde que fue puesta la humanidad sobre [la] tierra,
es.B: Sin duda sabes cómo ha sido desde antiguo, \q desde que los seres humanos fueron puestos en la tierra,
es.R: Seguro que sabes lo que es verdad desde hace mucho, \q desde que Dios puso a la gente en la tierra:

fr.L: Sais-tu cela depuis les temps anciens, \q depuis que l’humanité a été placée sur [la] terre,
fr.B: Tu le sais bien, il en est ainsi depuis toujours, \q depuis que les humains ont été placés sur la terre :
fr.R: Tu sais bien ce qui est vrai depuis très longtemps, \q depuis que Dieu a mis les humains sur la terre :

sw.L: Je, unajua hili tangu zamani, \q tangu wanadamu walipowekwa juu ya nchi,
sw.B: Hakika unajua jinsi ilivyokuwa tangu zamani, \q tangu wanadamu walipowekwa duniani,
sw.R: Bila shaka unajua yaliyo kweli tangu zamani sana, \q tangu Mungu alipowaweka watu duniani:

vi.L: Anh có biết điều này từ xưa, \q từ khi loài người được đặt trên đất,
vi.B: Hẳn anh biết điều vẫn luôn như thế từ xưa, \q từ khi loài người được đặt trên mặt đất,
vi.R: Chắc chắn anh biết điều vẫn đúng từ rất lâu, \q từ khi Đức Chúa Trời đặt con người trên mặt đất:

ko.L: 그대는 이것을 알지 않소? \q 옛적부터, 사람이 땅 위에 놓인 때부터 말이오.
ko.B: 예로부터 어떠했는지 그대도 분명히 알 것이오. \q 사람이 땅 위에 놓인 그때부터 말이오.
ko.R: 아주 오래전부터 변함없던 사실을 그대도 분명히 알 것이오. \q 하나님께서 사람을 땅 위에 두신 때부터 말이오.

decisions.choice: Do you know this?: a question that expects "yes"
decisions.reason: Zophar does not doubt that Job knows it. The question means "Surely you know": this is what everyone has always known (compare 8:8-10; 15:18). The sentence runs on into verse 5, which says what "this" is.

decisions.choice: since humankind was placed on earth: since the creation of human beings
decisions.reason: The phrase reaches back to the beginning (Deuteronomy 4:32; Genesis 2:7). The verb has no stated subject; it is God who placed human beings on the earth.

decisions.choice: Surely you know
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the question into the statement it means (m1).

decisions.choice: God put people
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who placed people on the earth, which the Hebrew implies (m2).

decisions.choice: Verse 4 closes as its own sentence ("…때부터 말이오."), and verse 5 says what "this" is
alternatives: one long sentence across verses 4-5 with the verb at the end of verse 5
decisions.reason: Korean puts the verb last, so the Hebrew sentence that runs from verse 4 into verse 5 would move "do you know" into verse 5. Each verse is closed as its own sentence so that each keeps its own content.

source.text: כִּ֤י רִנְנַ֣ת רְ֭שָׁעִים מִקָּר֑וֹב וְשִׂמְחַ֖ת חָנֵ֣ף עֲדֵי־רָֽגַע׃

records.literal_gloss: that the shout of joy of [the] wicked [is] from near, and the gladness of [the] godless until a moment?

en.L: that the rejoicing of [the] wicked [is] short, \q and the joy of the godless [lasts] for a moment?
en.B: that the triumph of the wicked is brief, \q and the joy of the godless lasts only a moment.
en.R: Wicked people do not shout for joy for long; \q the happiness of the godless lasts only a moment.

es.L: que el júbilo de [los] malvados [es] breve, \q y la alegría del impío [dura] un momento?
es.B: que el triunfo de los malvados es breve, \q y la alegría del impío dura solo un instante.
es.R: Los malvados no gritan de alegría por mucho tiempo; \q la felicidad de los impíos dura solo un momento.

fr.L: que l’allégresse des méchants [est] brève, \q et la joie de l’impie [ne dure qu’]un instant ?
fr.B: le triomphe des méchants est bref, \q et la joie de l’impie ne dure qu’un instant.
fr.R: Les méchants ne crient pas de joie bien longtemps ; \q le bonheur des impies ne dure qu’un instant.

sw.L: kwamba shangwe ya waovu [ni] ya muda mfupi, \q na furaha ya asiyemcha Mungu [hudumu] kitambo tu?
sw.B: kwamba shangwe ya waovu ni ya muda mfupi, \q na furaha ya asiyemcha Mungu hudumu kitambo tu.
sw.R: Waovu hawapigi kelele za furaha kwa muda mrefu; \q furaha ya wasiomcha Mungu hudumu kitambo tu.

vi.L: rằng tiếng reo mừng của kẻ ác [thì] ngắn ngủi, \q và niềm vui của kẻ vô đạo [chỉ] trong chốc lát?
vi.B: rằng sự đắc thắng của kẻ ác thật ngắn ngủi, \q và niềm vui của kẻ vô đạo chỉ trong chốc lát.
vi.R: Kẻ ác chẳng reo vui được bao lâu; \q niềm vui của kẻ vô đạo chỉ thoáng qua trong chốc lát.

ko.L: 곧 악인들의 환호는 짧고, \q 경건하지 않은 자의 기쁨은 잠깐뿐이라는 것을.
ko.B: 악인들의 승리는 짧고 \q 경건하지 않은 자의 기쁨은 잠깐뿐이라는 것이오.
ko.R: 악한 사람들은 오래 기뻐 소리치지 못한다. \q 하나님을 떠난 사람의 즐거움은 잠깐뿐이다.

decisions.choice: from near: short in time
decisions.reason: "From near" means close at hand in time, so soon over. The second line says the same: the joy lasts "until a moment".

decisions.choice: the godless: those who turn from God
decisions.reason: The word (chanef) is used in Job for the person who has turned from God, whatever he seems to be (8:13; 13:16; 15:34). Zophar's whole speech describes what happens to such a person.

decisions.choice: rejoicing: a shout of joy or triumph
decisions.reason: Renanah is a ringing cry of joy (3:7). It is the loud triumph of the wicked when things go well for them.

decisions.choice: Balanced ends the sentence with a full stop
decisions.reason: Balanced, like the English, turns the question of verse 4 into a statement ("Tu le sais bien"), so verse 5 says what is known rather than asking.

decisions.choice: "kẻ vô đạo" for the godless (chanef)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision takes the word as one who has turned from God; "kẻ vô đạo" says that, where "kẻ giả hình" (hypocrite) narrows it to pretending.

decisions.choice: "경건하지 않은 자" (L, B), "하나님을 떠난 사람" (R) for the godless
decisions.reason: The word is one who has turned from God (meaning decision m2); "위선자" (hypocrite) is the older rendering and narrows it. Readable says plainly what such a person has done.

source.text: אִם־יַעֲלֶ֣ה לַשָּׁמַ֣יִם שִׂיא֑וֹ וְ֝רֹאשׁ֗וֹ לָעָ֥ב יַגִּֽיעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: Though goes up to the heavens his height, and his head to [the] cloud[s] reaches,

en.L: Though his height goes up to the heavens \q and his head reaches to the clouds,
en.B: Though their pride rises up to the heavens \q and their heads touch the clouds,
en.R: Even if wicked people rise as high as the sky \q and their heads touch the clouds,

es.L: Aunque su altura suba hasta los cielos \q y su cabeza llegue hasta las nubes,
es.B: Aunque su orgullo se eleve hasta los cielos \q y sus cabezas toquen las nubes,
es.R: Aunque los malvados suban tan alto como el cielo \q y sus cabezas toquen las nubes,

fr.L: Même si sa hauteur monte jusqu’aux cieux \q et que sa tête atteint les nuées,
fr.B: Même si leur orgueil s’élève jusqu’aux cieux \q et que leur tête touche les nuages,
fr.R: Même si les méchants montent aussi haut que le ciel \q et que leur tête touche les nuages,

sw.L: Ijapokuwa kimo chake kinapanda hadi mbinguni, \q na kichwa chake kinafika mawinguni,
sw.B: Ijapokuwa kiburi chao kinapanda hadi mbinguni, \q na vichwa vyao vinagusa mawingu,
sw.R: Hata waovu wakipanda juu kama anga, \q na vichwa vyao vikagusa mawingu,

vi.L: Dù sự cao ngất của hắn lên đến các tầng trời, \q và đầu hắn chạm tới mây,
vi.B: Dù sự kiêu ngạo của chúng vươn lên tận trời \q và đầu chúng chạm đến mây,
vi.R: Dù kẻ ác có vươn cao tới tận trời \q và đầu chúng chạm đến mây,

ko.L: 그의 높음이 하늘까지 오르고 \q 그의 머리가 구름에 닿을지라도,
ko.B: 그들의 교만이 하늘까지 치솟고 \q 그들의 머리가 구름에 닿을지라도,
ko.R: 악한 사람들이 하늘만큼 높이 올라가고 \q 그 머리가 구름에 닿는다 해도,

decisions.choice: his height: his loftiness, with the sense of pride
decisions.reason: The word (si') occurs only here. It comes from the verb "to rise" and means height or exaltation; in a wicked person it is pride.

decisions.choice: up to the heavens: the proud who try to reach heaven
decisions.reason: The picture recalls the tower of Babel, whose builders wanted its top in the heavens (Genesis 11:4), and the king who said he would climb above the clouds (Isaiah 14:13-14).

decisions.choice: though: the sentence runs on into verse 7
decisions.reason: "Though" begins a condition whose result comes in verse 7: however high he rises, he will perish.

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

decisions.choice: wicked people
decisions.reason: Readable names who is meant, since a new reader would not know whose height is meant.

decisions.choice: "그" (Literal), "그들" or "악한 사람들" (Balanced, Readable) for the wicked person, through the speech
decisions.reason: Korean often leaves the subject unspoken, but this long description of "him" needs a subject now and then. Literal keeps the Hebrew singular "그"; Balanced and Readable use the plural, as the English does, and Readable names "악한 사람들" where the English says "wicked people".

source.text: כְּֽ֭גֶלֲלוֹ לָנֶ֣צַח יֹאבֵ֑ד רֹ֝אָ֗יו יֹאמְר֥וּ אַיּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Like his dung forever he will perish; those who saw him will say, Where [is] he?

en.L: like his own dung he will perish forever; \q those who saw him will say, "Where [is] he?"
en.B: they will perish forever like their own dung; \q those who used to see them will ask, "Where are they?"
en.R: they will be gone forever, thrown away like dung. \q People who used to see them will ask, "Where did they go?"

es.L: como su propio estiércol perecerá para siempre; \q los que lo veían dirán: «¿Dónde [está] él?»
es.B: perecerán para siempre como su propio estiércol; \q los que solían verlos preguntarán: «¿Dónde están?»
es.R: desaparecerán para siempre, tirados como estiércol. \q La gente que los veía preguntará: «¿Adónde se fueron?»

fr.L: comme ses propres excréments, il périra pour toujours ; \q ceux qui le voyaient diront : « Où [est]-il ? »
fr.B: ils périront pour toujours comme leurs propres excréments ; \q ceux qui les voyaient demanderont : « Où sont-ils ? »
fr.R: ils disparaîtront pour toujours, jetés comme du fumier. \q Ceux qui les voyaient demanderont : « Où sont-ils passés ? »

sw.L: kama mavi yake mwenyewe ataangamia milele; \q wale waliomwona watasema, "Yuko wapi?"
sw.B: wataangamia milele kama mavi yao wenyewe; \q wale waliozoea kuwaona watauliza, "Wako wapi?"
sw.R: watatoweka milele, wakitupwa kama mavi. \q Watu waliokuwa wakiwaona watauliza, "Wamekwenda wapi?"

vi.L: hắn sẽ bị tiêu diệt đời đời như phân của chính mình; \q những người đã thấy hắn sẽ nói: "Hắn [ở] đâu?"
vi.B: chúng sẽ bị diệt mất đời đời như phân của chính mình; \q những ai từng thấy chúng sẽ hỏi: "Chúng ở đâu rồi?"
vi.R: chúng sẽ biến mất mãi mãi, bị vứt đi như phân. \q Những người từng thấy chúng sẽ hỏi: "Chúng đi đâu mất rồi?"

ko.L: 그는 자기 똥처럼 영원히 망할 것이다. \q 그를 보던 자들이 "그가 어디 [있느냐]?" 하고 말할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 자기 똥처럼 영원히 망할 것이다. \q 그들을 보던 사람들이 "그들이 어디 있느냐?" 하고 물을 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 똥처럼 내버려져 영원히 사라질 것이다. \q 그들을 보던 사람들이 "그들이 어디 갔느냐?" 하고 물을 것이다.

decisions.choice: dung: a crude picture of contempt
decisions.reason: Gelel is dung. Zophar chooses a coarse picture on purpose: the one who rose to the clouds ends like refuse that is thrown out and gone (1 Kings 14:10 uses a related word for sweeping away filth).

decisions.choice: Where is he?: he has vanished without a trace
decisions.reason: The question means he is nowhere to be found, as Job himself said of a person who dies (14:10).

decisions.choice: forever: for good
decisions.reason: La-netsach means for all time: there is no coming back.

decisions.choice: thrown away like dung
decisions.reason: Readable says what the comparison means (m1).

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

decisions.choice: "excréments" (Literal, Balanced), "fumier" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Zophar chooses a coarse picture on purpose (meaning decision m1); "excréments" keeps it. Readable, where the English says "thrown away like dung", uses "fumier", the everyday word for dung thrown out of a stable.

source.text: כַּחֲל֣וֹם יָ֭עוּף וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָא֑וּהוּ וְ֝יֻדַּ֗ד כְּחֶזְי֥וֹן לָֽיְלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Like a dream he will fly away and they will not find him, and he will be chased away like a vision of [the] night.

en.L: Like a dream he will fly away, and they will not find him; \q he will be chased away like a vision of the night.
en.B: They will fly away like a dream and not be found; \q they will be driven off like a vision in the night.
en.R: They will vanish like a dream, and no one will find them. \q They will disappear like something seen in the night.

es.L: Como un sueño volará, y no lo hallarán; \q será ahuyentado como una visión de la noche.
es.B: Volarán como un sueño y no serán hallados; \q serán ahuyentados como una visión nocturna.
es.R: Se desvanecerán como un sueño, y nadie los encontrará. \q Desaparecerán como algo visto en la noche.

fr.L: Comme un rêve il s’envolera, et on ne le trouvera pas ; \q il sera chassé comme une vision de la nuit.
fr.B: Ils s’envoleront comme un rêve, et on ne les trouvera plus ; \q ils seront chassés comme une vision nocturne.
fr.R: Ils disparaîtront comme un rêve, et personne ne les retrouvera. \q Ils s’évanouiront comme ce qu’on voit dans la nuit.

sw.L: Kama ndoto ataruka, wala hawatamwona; \q atafukuzwa kama maono ya usiku.
sw.B: Wataruka kama ndoto, wala hawataonekana; \q watafukuzwa kama maono ya usiku.
sw.R: Watatoweka kama ndoto, wala hakuna atakayewaona. \q Watapotea kama kitu kilichoonekana usiku.

vi.L: Như một giấc mơ hắn sẽ bay đi, và người ta sẽ không tìm thấy hắn; \q hắn sẽ bị xua đuổi như một khải tượng ban đêm.
vi.B: Chúng sẽ bay đi như một giấc mơ, chẳng ai tìm thấy; \q chúng sẽ bị xua tan như một khải tượng lúc ban đêm.
vi.R: Chúng sẽ tan biến như một giấc mơ, không ai tìm thấy chúng nữa. \q Chúng sẽ biến mất như điều người ta thấy trong đêm.

ko.L: 그는 꿈처럼 날아가 버려 사람들이 그를 찾지 못할 것이다. \q 밤의 환상처럼 쫓겨날 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 꿈처럼 날아가 다시는 찾을 수 없을 것이다. \q 밤에 본 환상처럼 쫓겨 사라질 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 꿈처럼 사라져서 아무도 그들을 찾지 못할 것이다. \q 밤에 본 것처럼 없어질 것이다.

decisions.choice: a vision of the night: a dream
decisions.reason: Chizzayon is a vision; a vision of the night is a dream (4:13; 33:15). Both lines say the same: he passes like a dream that is gone when one wakes (Psalm 73:20; Isaiah 29:7-8).

decisions.choice: they will not find him: no one will find him
decisions.reason: The plural verb has no stated subject; it means simply that he cannot be found.

decisions.choice: chased away: driven off
decisions.reason: The verb (nadad) means to flee or be put to flight. Bildad used it of the wicked being chased out of the world (18:18).

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

source.text: עַ֣יִן שְׁ֭זָפַתּוּ וְלֹ֣א תוֹסִ֑יף וְלֹא־ע֝֗וֹד תְּשׁוּרֶ֥נּוּ מְקוֹמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: An eye caught sight of him and will not again, and not again will his place behold him.

en.L: The eye that saw him will not [see him] again, \q and his place will no longer behold him.
en.B: The eye that once saw them will not see them again; \q their place will look on them no more.
en.R: People who once saw them will never see them again. \q Their own home will never see them again.

es.L: El ojo que lo vio no [lo verá] más, \q y su lugar ya no lo contemplará.
es.B: El ojo que antes los veía no los volverá a ver; \q su lugar no los verá nunca más.
es.R: Los que antes los veían nunca más los verán. \q Su propia casa no los volverá a ver.

fr.L: L’œil qui l’a aperçu ne [le verra] plus, \q et son lieu ne le contemplera plus.
fr.B: L’œil qui les voyait ne les verra plus ; \q leur demeure ne les reverra jamais.
fr.R: Ceux qui les voyaient ne les reverront jamais. \q Leur propre maison ne les reverra plus.

sw.L: Jicho lililomtazama halitarudia [kumwona], \q wala mahali pake hapatamwona tena.
sw.B: Jicho lililowaona zamani halitawaona tena; \q mahali pao hapatawatazama tena.
sw.R: Watu waliowaona zamani hawatawaona tena kamwe. \q Nyumba yao wenyewe haitawaona tena.

vi.L: Con mắt đã thấy hắn sẽ không [thấy hắn] nữa, \q và nơi ở của hắn sẽ không còn nhìn thấy hắn.
vi.B: Con mắt từng thấy chúng sẽ không còn thấy chúng nữa; \q nơi chúng ở sẽ chẳng bao giờ nhìn thấy chúng nữa.
vi.R: Người từng thấy chúng sẽ chẳng bao giờ thấy chúng nữa. \q Chính ngôi nhà của chúng cũng sẽ không còn thấy chúng.

ko.L: 그를 본 눈이 다시는 [그를 보지] 못하고, \q 그의 처소도 다시는 그를 바라보지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들을 보던 눈이 다시는 그들을 보지 못하고, \q 그들이 살던 곳도 다시는 그들을 보지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 그들을 보던 사람들이 다시는 그들을 보지 못할 것이다. \q 그들이 살던 집조차 다시는 그들을 보지 못할 것이다.

decisions.choice: the eye ... his place: Job's own words turned against him
decisions.reason: Job said of himself, "The eye of the one who sees me will not see me again," and of any who die, "his place will not know him any more" (7:8, 10). Zophar applies these words to the wicked.

decisions.choice: caught sight of: glanced at, saw
decisions.reason: The verb (shazaf) is a rare word for seeing, used of the sun that has looked on someone (Song of Songs 1:6) and of a bird's eye (28:7).

decisions.choice: [see him]
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "will not again"; Literal brackets the verb English needs.

decisions.choice: their own home
decisions.reason: Readable says "home" for the place where the person lived.

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

source.text: בָּ֭נָיו יְרַצּ֣וּ דַלִּ֑ים וְ֝יָדָ֗יו תָּשֵׁ֥בְנָה אוֹנֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: His sons will seek the favor of [the] poor, and his hands will give back his wealth.

en.L: His sons will seek the favor of [the] poor, \q and his hands will give back his wealth.
en.B: Their children will have to make amends to the poor; \q their own hands must give back their wealth.
en.R: Their children will have to pay back the poor, \q and they themselves will have to give back their wealth.

es.L: Sus hijos buscarán el favor de [los] pobres, \q y sus manos devolverán su riqueza.
es.B: Sus hijos tendrán que resarcir a los pobres; \q sus propias manos deberán devolver su riqueza.
es.R: Sus hijos tendrán que pagarles a los pobres, \q y ellos mismos tendrán que devolver su riqueza.

fr.L: Ses fils rechercheront la faveur des pauvres, \q et ses mains rendront sa richesse.
fr.B: Leurs enfants devront dédommager les pauvres ; \q leurs propres mains devront restituer leur richesse.
fr.R: Leurs enfants devront rembourser les pauvres, \q et eux-mêmes devront rendre leurs richesses.

sw.L: Wana wake watatafuta kibali cha maskini, \q na mikono yake itarudisha mali yake.
sw.B: Watoto wao watalazimika kuwafidia maskini; \q mikono yao wenyewe itarudisha mali yao.
sw.R: Watoto wao watalazimika kuwalipa maskini, \q nao wenyewe watalazimika kurudisha mali yao.

vi.L: Các con trai hắn sẽ tìm ân huệ của người nghèo, \q và tay hắn sẽ trả lại của cải hắn.
vi.B: Con cái chúng sẽ phải đền bù cho người nghèo; \q chính tay chúng phải trả lại của cải mình.
vi.R: Con cái chúng sẽ phải đền trả cho người nghèo, \q và chính chúng cũng phải trả lại của cải mình.

ko.L: 그의 아들들은 가난한 자들의 호의를 구할 것이고, \q 그의 손은 그의 재물을 돌려줄 것이다.
ko.B: 그들의 자녀들은 가난한 사람들에게 배상해야 하고, \q 그들은 자기 손으로 재물을 돌려주어야 할 것이다.
ko.R: 그들의 자녀들은 가난한 사람들에게 갚아 주어야 하고, \q 그들 자신도 재물을 돌려주어야 할 것이다.

decisions.choice: seek the favor of the poor: have to win over and repay those he wronged
alternatives: the poor will crush his children
decisions.reason: The verb (ratsah) means to be pleased with, and in this form to seek favor or make amends (Leviticus 26:41, 43 uses it for paying off a debt of guilt). The sons must humble themselves before the poor their father robbed (20:19). A small change of one letter gives "the poor will crush his sons".

decisions.choice: his wealth
decisions.reason: 'On can mean strength (18:7, 12) or wealth (Hosea 12:9). Here, with "give back", it is the wealth he gained by force.

decisions.choice: sons: here children
decisions.reason: The word is "sons" (banim), and the plural can include daughters (8:4).

decisions.choice: children
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "children" (m3); Literal keeps "sons".

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

decisions.choice: "hijos" at every level
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" means sons and, in the plural, children of both sexes, so one word covers the Literal "sons" and the Balanced and Readable "children" (meaning decision m3); no gender setting is needed.

source.text: עַ֭צְמוֹתָיו מָלְא֣וּ עֲלוּמָ֑יו וְ֝עִמּ֗וֹ עַל־עָפָ֥ר תִּשְׁכָּֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: His bones were full of his youthful vigor, and with him on the dust it will lie down.

en.L: His bones were full of his youthful vigor, \q but it will lie down with him in the dust.
en.B: Their bones were full of youthful strength, \q but it will lie down with them in the dust.
en.R: Their bodies were full of the strength of youth, \q but that strength will be buried with them.

es.L: Sus huesos estaban llenos de su vigor juvenil, \q pero este yacerá con él en el polvo.
es.B: Sus huesos estaban llenos de fuerza juvenil, \q pero esa fuerza yacerá con ellos en el polvo.
es.R: Sus cuerpos estaban llenos de la fuerza de la juventud, \q pero esa fuerza será enterrada con ellos.

fr.L: Ses os étaient pleins de sa vigueur juvénile, \q mais elle se couchera avec lui dans la poussière.
fr.B: Leurs os étaient pleins de la force de la jeunesse, \q mais elle se couchera avec eux dans la poussière.
fr.R: Leur corps était plein de la force de la jeunesse, \q mais cette force sera enterrée avec eux.

sw.L: Mifupa yake ilijaa nguvu za ujana wake, \q lakini zitalala pamoja naye mavumbini.
sw.B: Mifupa yao ilijaa nguvu za ujana, \q lakini nguvu hizo zitalala pamoja nao mavumbini.
sw.R: Miili yao ilijaa nguvu za ujana, \q lakini nguvu hizo zitazikwa pamoja nao.

vi.L: Xương cốt hắn đầy sức sống tuổi trẻ của hắn, \q nhưng nó sẽ nằm xuống với hắn trong bụi đất.
vi.B: Xương cốt chúng từng đầy sức mạnh tuổi xuân, \q nhưng sức ấy sẽ nằm xuống cùng chúng trong bụi đất.
vi.R: Thân thể chúng từng tràn đầy sức trẻ, \q nhưng sức ấy sẽ bị chôn vùi cùng với chúng.

ko.L: 그의 뼈는 그의 젊은 기력으로 가득했으나, \q 그것이 그와 함께 티끌 위에 누울 것이다.
ko.B: 그들의 뼈는 젊음의 힘으로 가득했으나, \q 그 힘이 그들과 함께 티끌 속에 누울 것이다.
ko.R: 그들의 몸은 젊음의 힘으로 가득했지만, \q 그 힘도 그들과 함께 묻힐 것이다.

decisions.choice: youthful vigor: the strength of youth
decisions.reason: 'Alumim is youth (33:25; Psalm 89:46). The word could also be taken from the verb "to hide" ('alam), giving "his secret sins", but the parallel with full bones points to youthful strength.

decisions.choice: lie down in the dust: die and be buried
decisions.reason: To lie in the dust is to be in the grave (7:21; 21:26). He dies while still strong, and his strength is buried with him.

decisions.choice: it: his vigor
decisions.reason: The verb is feminine singular. It most likely refers to his vigor, though it may take the bones together as one.

decisions.choice: bodies ... buried with them
alternatives: bones ... lie down with them in the dust
decisions.reason: Readable says "bodies" for the bones, which stand for the whole person, and explains the idiom (m2).

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

source.text: אִם־תַּמְתִּ֣יק בְּפִ֣יו רָעָ֑ה יַ֝כְחִידֶ֗נָּה תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Though evil tastes sweet in his mouth, he hides it under his tongue,

en.L: Though evil is sweet in his mouth, \q [though] he hides it under his tongue,
en.B: Though evil tastes sweet in their mouth \q and they hide it under their tongue,
en.R: Evil may taste sweet to the wicked, \q so that they hold it under their tongue to enjoy it longer,

es.L: Aunque el mal sea dulce en su boca, \q [aunque] lo esconda debajo de su lengua,
es.B: Aunque el mal les sepa dulce en la boca \q y lo escondan debajo de la lengua,
es.R: Puede que el mal les sepa dulce a los malvados, \q tanto que lo guardan bajo la lengua para disfrutarlo más tiempo,

fr.L: Si le mal est doux dans sa bouche, \q [s’]il le cache sous sa langue,
fr.B: Même si le mal a un goût sucré dans leur bouche \q et qu’ils le cachent sous leur langue,
fr.R: Le mal a beau avoir bon goût pour les méchants, \q au point qu’ils le gardent sous la langue pour en profiter plus longtemps,

sw.L: Ijapokuwa uovu ni mtamu kinywani mwake, \q [ijapokuwa] anauficha chini ya ulimi wake,
sw.B: Ijapokuwa uovu una ladha tamu vinywani mwao \q nao wanauficha chini ya ndimi zao,
sw.R: Uovu unaweza kuwa mtamu kwa waovu, \q hata wakaushika chini ya ulimi ili kuufurahia muda mrefu zaidi,

vi.L: Dù điều ác ngọt ngào trong miệng hắn, \q [dù] hắn giấu nó dưới lưỡi mình,
vi.B: Dù điều ác có vị ngọt trong miệng chúng \q và chúng giấu nó dưới lưỡi,
vi.R: Kẻ ác có thể thấy điều ác ngọt ngào, \q đến nỗi ngậm nó dưới lưỡi để hưởng lâu hơn,

ko.L: 악이 그의 입에 달아 \q [비록] 그가 그것을 혀 밑에 감추고,
ko.B: 악이 그들의 입에 달콤하여 \q 그들이 그것을 혀 밑에 감추고,
ko.R: 악한 사람들에게는 악이 달콤하게 느껴질 수도 있다. \q 그래서 그 맛을 더 오래 즐기려고 혀 밑에 물고 있기도 한다.

decisions.choice: sweet in the mouth, hidden under the tongue: evil savored like a treat
decisions.reason: Wrongdoing is pictured as tasty food that a person holds in the mouth to make the taste last (Proverbs 9:17; 20:17).

decisions.choice: though: verses 12-13 lead up to verse 14
decisions.reason: The "though" clause runs through verse 13; the result comes in verse 14, where the sweet food turns to poison.

decisions.choice: to enjoy it longer
decisions.reason: Readable says why someone would hold food under the tongue (m1).

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

decisions.choice: Readable closes verses 12 and 13 as sentences of their own
decisions.reason: Korean puts the main verb last, so the "though" clauses of verses 12-13 cannot wait for verse 14 in a short Readable sentence. Each verse is closed, and verse 14 begins "그러나", as the English Readable begins "But".

source.text: יַחְמֹ֣ל עָ֭לֶיהָ וְלֹ֣א יַֽעַזְבֶ֑נָּה וְ֝יִמְנָעֶ֗נָּה בְּת֣וֹךְ חִכּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: he spares it and does not let it go, and holds it back in the midst of his palate,

en.L: [though] he spares it and does not let it go, \q and holds it back in the middle of his palate,
en.B: though they cannot bear to let it go \q but keep it in their mouth,
en.R: They cannot bear to let it go, \q so they keep it in their mouth.

es.L: [aunque] lo guarde y no lo suelte, \q y lo retenga en medio de su paladar,
es.B: aunque no soporten soltarlo \q y lo retengan en la boca,
es.R: No soportan dejarlo ir, \q así que lo mantienen en la boca.

fr.L: [s’]il l’épargne et ne le lâche pas, \q et le retient au milieu de son palais,
fr.B: s’ils ne peuvent se résoudre à le lâcher \q mais le gardent dans leur bouche,
fr.R: Ils ne supportent pas de le lâcher, \q alors ils le gardent dans la bouche.

sw.L: [ijapokuwa] anauhurumia wala hauachi, \q bali anauzuia katikati ya kaakaa lake,
sw.B: ijapokuwa hawawezi kuvumilia kuuachilia \q bali wanauweka vinywani mwao,
sw.R: Hawawezi kukubali kuuachilia, \q kwa hiyo wanauweka mdomoni.

vi.L: [dù] hắn tiếc nó và không buông ra, \q và giữ nó lại giữa vòm miệng mình,
vi.B: dù chúng chẳng nỡ buông nó ra \q mà cứ ngậm giữ trong miệng,
vi.R: Chúng không nỡ nhả nó ra, \q nên cứ ngậm mãi trong miệng.

ko.L: 그것을 아까워하여 놓지 않고 \q 그의 입천장 한가운데에 붙들어 둘지라도,
ko.B: 차마 그것을 놓지 못하고 \q 입안에 계속 머금고 있을지라도,
ko.R: 차마 그것을 놓지 못해서 \q 입안에 계속 머금고 있다.

decisions.choice: spares it: is loath to part with it
decisions.reason: The verb (chamal) means to have pity on or spare. He cannot bring himself to part with the sweet morsel of evil.

decisions.choice: palate: the roof of the mouth
decisions.reason: Chekh is the palate, where taste is felt (6:30; 12:11).

decisions.choice: cannot bear to let it go ... mouth
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put "spares it" into plain English and say "mouth" for the palate.

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

source.text: לַ֭חְמוֹ בְּמֵעָ֣יו נֶהְפָּ֑ךְ מְרוֹרַ֖ת פְּתָנִ֣ים בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: His food in his bowels is turned; [the] venom of cobras [is] in his inner parts.

en.L: his food in his bowels is turned; \q [it is] the venom of cobras within him.
en.B: their food turns sour in their stomach; \q it becomes the venom of cobras inside them.
en.R: But that food turns sour in their stomach. \q It becomes like snake poison inside them.

es.L: su comida en sus entrañas se transforma; \q [es] veneno de cobras dentro de él.
es.B: su comida se les agria en el estómago; \q se convierte en veneno de cobra dentro de ellos.
es.R: Pero esa comida se les agria en el estómago. \q Se vuelve como veneno de serpiente dentro de ellos.

fr.L: sa nourriture dans ses entrailles est changée ; \q [c’est] du venin de cobras au-dedans de lui.
fr.B: leur nourriture tourne dans leur estomac ; \q elle devient du venin de cobra au-dedans d’eux.
fr.R: Mais cette nourriture tourne mal dans leur estomac. \q Elle devient comme du venin de serpent en eux.

sw.L: chakula chake tumboni mwake kimegeuka; \q [ni] sumu ya swila ndani yake.
sw.B: chakula chao kinachachuka matumboni mwao; \q kinakuwa sumu ya swila ndani yao.
sw.R: Lakini chakula hicho kinachachuka tumboni mwao. \q Kinakuwa kama sumu ya nyoka ndani yao.

vi.L: thức ăn của hắn trong ruột gan bị biến đổi; \q [thành] nọc rắn hổ mang ở bên trong hắn.
vi.B: thức ăn của chúng hóa chua trong bụng; \q nó trở thành nọc rắn hổ mang bên trong chúng.
vi.R: Nhưng thức ăn ấy hóa chua trong bụng chúng. \q Nó trở thành như nọc rắn độc ở bên trong chúng.

ko.L: 그의 음식이 그의 창자 속에서 변하여 \q 그의 속에서 코브라의 독이 [될 것이다].
ko.B: 그들의 음식은 뱃속에서 상하여 \q 그들 안에서 코브라의 독이 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 그 음식은 뱃속에서 상하고 \q 몸 안에서 뱀의 독처럼 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: venom: bitter poison
decisions.reason: Merorah is bitterness: the bitter gall of the body (16:13) and the venom of snakes (Deuteronomy 32:33 has a related word). The sweet food of verse 12 becomes poison.

decisions.choice: cobras: deadly snakes
decisions.reason: Peten is a poisonous snake, most likely the cobra (Deuteronomy 32:33; Psalm 58:5; Isaiah 11:8).

decisions.choice: is turned: the result of verses 12-13
decisions.reason: This is the main clause the "though" of verse 12 was leading to.

decisions.choice: turns sour / becomes
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the food is turned into.

decisions.choice: like snake poison
decisions.reason: Readable makes the comparison explicit and uses a common word for the snake.

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

decisions.choice: "swila" for the cobra (peten) here and in verse 16; "kifutu" for the viper of verse 16
decisions.reason: "Swila" is the Swahili name for the cobra and "kifutu" for the puff adder, a desert viper, which match the two snakes the meaning decisions name. Readable says simply "nyoka" (snake), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "코브라" for the cobra (peten), "독사" for the viper of verse 16
decisions.reason: The meaning decision names the cobra; "코브라" is the plain modern name, and "독사" (a poisonous snake, a viper) is kept for the second snake in verse 16 so that the two stay distinct. Readable says "뱀" (snake), as the English Readable does.

source.text: חַ֣יִל בָּ֭לַע וַיְקִאֶ֑נּוּ מִ֝בִּטְנ֗וֹ יוֹרִשֶׁ֥נּוּ אֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Wealth he swallowed, and he vomits it up; from his belly God drives it out.

en.L: He swallowed wealth and vomits it up; \q God drives it out of his belly.
en.B: They swallow riches but vomit them up again; \q God makes their stomach throw them out.
en.R: They gobble up riches, but they will vomit them up again. \q God will force those riches out of their stomach.

es.L: Tragó riquezas y las vomita; \q Dios las expulsa de su vientre.
es.B: Se tragan las riquezas, pero las vuelven a vomitar; \q Dios hace que su estómago las expulse.
es.R: Devoran riquezas, pero las vomitarán. \q Dios les sacará esas riquezas del estómago.

fr.L: Il a englouti la richesse et il la vomit ; \q Dieu la chasse de son ventre.
fr.B: Ils engloutissent des richesses, mais les vomissent ; \q Dieu les fait rejeter par leur estomac.
fr.R: Ils avalent goulûment les richesses, mais ils vont les vomir. \q Dieu fera sortir ces richesses de leur estomac.

sw.L: Alimeza mali, naye anaitapika; \q Mungu anaifukuza kutoka tumboni mwake.
sw.B: Wanameza utajiri lakini wanautapika tena; \q Mungu anayafanya matumbo yao yautoe nje.
sw.R: Wanameza utajiri kwa pupa, lakini watautapika tena. \q Mungu atautoa utajiri huo tumboni mwao kwa nguvu.

vi.L: Hắn đã nuốt của cải và nôn nó ra; \q Đức Chúa Trời tống nó ra khỏi bụng hắn.
vi.B: Chúng nuốt của cải nhưng lại nôn ra; \q Đức Chúa Trời khiến bụng chúng phải tống ra.
vi.R: Chúng ngấu nghiến của cải, nhưng rồi sẽ phải nôn ra. \q Đức Chúa Trời sẽ buộc của cải ấy ra khỏi bụng chúng.

ko.L: 그가 재물을 삼켰으나 그것을 토하니, \q 하나님께서 그의 배에서 그것을 쫓아내실 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 재물을 삼키지만 다시 토해 낼 것이다. \q 하나님께서 그들의 배가 그것을 게워 내게 하실 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 재물을 마구 삼키지만 다시 토해 낼 것이다. \q 하나님께서 그 재물을 그들의 배에서 억지로 꺼내실 것이다.

decisions.choice: swallowed wealth: got rich by devouring what belonged to others
decisions.reason: Swallowing is greedy taking (Proverbs 1:12). Zophar carries on the picture of food from verses 12-14: wealth seized from the poor (20:19) will not stay down.

decisions.choice: wealth
decisions.reason: Chayil can mean strength or wealth; with "swallow" and "vomit" it is the riches he gained (20:18).

decisions.choice: God drives it out: the first mention of God in the speech
decisions.reason: Up to here the wicked seem to fall of themselves. Now Zophar names God ('El) as the one who makes him give up what he took. The verb (yarash, in this form) means to drive out or dispossess.

decisions.choice: makes their stomach throw them out / force those riches out
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep the picture of vomiting from the first line, which "drives it out" continues.

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

source.text: רֹאשׁ־פְּתָנִ֥ים יִינָ֑ק תַּֽ֝הַרְגֵ֗הוּ לְשׁ֣וֹן אֶפְעֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] poison of cobras he sucks; the tongue of a viper will kill him.

en.L: He sucks the poison of cobras; \q the tongue of a viper will kill him.
en.B: They suck the poison of cobras; \q the viper's fangs will kill them.
en.R: What they swallowed will be like snake poison to them, \q and it will kill them like a viper's bite.

es.L: Chupa veneno de cobras; \q la lengua de la víbora lo matará.
es.B: Chupan veneno de cobras; \q los colmillos de la víbora los matarán.
es.R: Lo que se tragaron será para ellos como veneno de serpiente, \q y los matará como la mordedura de una víbora.

fr.L: Il suce le poison des cobras ; \q la langue de la vipère le tuera.
fr.B: Ils sucent le poison des cobras ; \q les crochets de la vipère les tueront.
fr.R: Ce qu’ils ont avalé sera pour eux comme du venin de serpent, \q et cela les tuera comme une morsure de vipère.

sw.L: Ananyonya sumu ya swila; \q ulimi wa kifutu utamuua.
sw.B: Wananyonya sumu ya swila; \q meno ya kifutu yatawaua.
sw.R: Walichokimeza kitakuwa kama sumu ya nyoka kwao, \q nacho kitawaua kama kuumwa na kifutu.

vi.L: Hắn hút nọc độc của rắn hổ mang; \q lưỡi của rắn lục sẽ giết hắn.
vi.B: Chúng hút nọc rắn hổ mang; \q nanh rắn lục sẽ giết chúng.
vi.R: Những gì chúng nuốt vào sẽ như nọc rắn đối với chúng, \q và sẽ giết chúng như vết rắn lục cắn.

ko.L: 그는 코브라의 독을 빨 것이니, \q 독사의 혀가 그를 죽일 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 코브라의 독을 빨아들이니, \q 독사의 이빨이 그들을 죽일 것이다.
ko.R: 그들이 삼킨 것이 그들에게 뱀의 독과 같아서, \q 독사에게 물린 것처럼 그들을 죽일 것이다.

decisions.choice: poison
decisions.reason: Rosh usually means "head", but a second word with the same letters means poison (Deuteronomy 32:32-33).

decisions.choice: the tongue of a viper: its deadly strike
decisions.reason: The snake's tongue stands for its strike. The poison he sucked in with his ill-gotten food (20:14) is what kills him.

decisions.choice: viper: a poisonous snake
decisions.reason: 'Ef'eh is a poisonous snake of the desert (Isaiah 30:6; 59:5).

decisions.choice: fangs
decisions.reason: Balanced says "fangs", since English readers think of a snake killing by its bite (m2).

decisions.choice: What they swallowed will be like snake poison
alternatives: they suck the poison of cobras
decisions.reason: Readable shows that the poison is the stolen wealth of verses 14-15.

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

source.text: אַל־יֵ֥רֶא בִפְלַגּ֑וֹת נַהֲרֵ֥י נַ֝חֲלֵ֗י דְּבַ֣שׁ וְחֶמְאָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Let him not look on streams, rivers, torrents of honey and curds.

en.L: He will not look on [the] streams, \q [the] rivers, [the] torrents of honey and curds.
en.B: They will never enjoy the streams, \q the rivers flowing with honey and cream.
en.R: They will never enjoy the good things of the land, \q its rivers of honey and cream.

es.L: No mirará los arroyos, \q los ríos, los torrentes de miel y cuajada.
es.B: Nunca disfrutarán de los arroyos, \q de los ríos que fluyen con miel y nata.
es.R: Nunca disfrutarán de las cosas buenas de la tierra, \q de sus ríos de miel y nata.

fr.L: Il ne verra pas les ruisseaux, \q les fleuves, les torrents de miel et de lait caillé.
fr.B: Ils ne jouiront jamais des ruisseaux, \q des fleuves où coulent le miel et la crème.
fr.R: Ils ne profiteront jamais des bonnes choses du pays, \q de ses rivières de miel et de crème.

sw.L: Hataitazama mito, \q mito mikubwa, vijito vya asali na maziwa mgando.
sw.B: Hawatafurahia kamwe vijito, \q mito inayotiririka asali na malai.
sw.R: Hawatafurahia kamwe mambo mema ya nchi, \q mito yake ya asali na malai.

vi.L: Hắn sẽ không nhìn thấy những dòng suối, \q những con sông, những dòng thác mật ong và sữa đông.
vi.B: Chúng sẽ chẳng bao giờ được hưởng những dòng suối, \q những con sông tuôn chảy mật ong và váng sữa.
vi.R: Chúng sẽ chẳng bao giờ được hưởng những điều tốt lành của xứ, \q những dòng sông đầy mật ong và váng sữa.

ko.L: 그는 시냇물들을, \q 꿀과 엉긴 젖이 흐르는 강들과 급류들을 보지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 시냇물들을, \q 꿀과 진한 젖이 흐르는 강들을 결코 누리지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 그 땅의 좋은 것들을, \q 꿀과 진한 젖이 흐르는 강들을 결코 누리지 못할 것이다.

decisions.choice: will not look on: a strong denial
decisions.reason: The negative 'al with this verb form usually expresses a wish ("let him not"), but in poetry it can state firmly what will not happen. Either way he will not enjoy them.

decisions.choice: look on: enjoy
decisions.reason: To look on good things is to enjoy them (Psalm 27:13; Ecclesiastes 2:1).

decisions.choice: honey and curds: the plenty of a good land
decisions.reason: Honey and milk are the riches of the land God promised (Exodus 3:8). Curds (chem'ah) are thickened milk or butter (Genesis 18:8); Job uses the word of his own past plenty (29:6).

decisions.choice: cream
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "cream", a rich milk food familiar to English readers; Literal keeps "curds".

decisions.choice: the good things of the land
decisions.reason: Readable says what the streams of honey and cream stand for (m3).

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

decisions.choice: "진한 젖" (Balanced, Readable) for the curds, "엉긴 젖" at Literal
decisions.reason: The English Balanced says "cream" for a rich milk food; "크림" sounds modern and foreign in this poetry, so Korean says "rich milk". Literal keeps "엉긴 젖" (curdled milk), what the Hebrew word names.

source.text: מֵשִׁ֣יב יָ֭גָע וְלֹ֣א יִבְלָ֑ע כְּחֵ֥יל תְּ֝מוּרָת֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲלֹֽס׃

records.literal_gloss: Restoring [the] gain [of toil], and he does not swallow [it]; according to the wealth of his exchange, and he does not rejoice.

en.L: [He] gives back [the] fruit of [his] toil and does not swallow [it]; \q from the wealth of his trading he does not rejoice.
en.B: They must give back what they toiled for and cannot swallow it; \q they get no joy from the profits of their trading.
en.R: They will have to give back what they worked for before they can enjoy it. \q They will get no pleasure from the money they made.

es.L: Devuelve [el] fruto de [su] fatiga y no [lo] traga; \q de la riqueza de su comercio no se alegra.
es.B: Tienen que devolver aquello por lo que se fatigaron y no pueden tragarlo; \q no sacan alegría de las ganancias de su comercio.
es.R: Tendrán que devolver lo que ganaron antes de poder disfrutarlo. \q El dinero que hicieron no les dará ningún placer.

fr.L: [Il] rend [le] fruit de [son] labeur et ne [l’]avale pas ; \q de la richesse de son commerce il ne se réjouit pas.
fr.B: Ils doivent rendre le fruit de leur peine sans pouvoir l’avaler ; \q ils ne tirent aucune joie des profits de leur commerce.
fr.R: Ils devront rendre ce qu’ils ont gagné avant de pouvoir en profiter. \q L’argent qu’ils ont amassé ne leur donnera aucun plaisir.

sw.L: Anarudisha mapato ya kazi [yake] wala hayamezi; \q kwa mali ya biashara yake hafurahi.
sw.B: Wanalazimika kurudisha walichokitaabikia, wala hawawezi kukimeza; \q hawapati furaha kutokana na faida ya biashara yao.
sw.R: Watalazimika kurudisha walichokifanyia kazi kabla ya kukifurahia. \q Pesa walizopata hazitawapa furaha yoyote.

vi.L: [Hắn] trả lại [hoa lợi của] công lao [mình] và không nuốt [nó]; \q với của cải từ việc buôn bán của mình, hắn không vui hưởng.
vi.B: Chúng phải trả lại những gì đã nhọc công làm ra mà chẳng nuốt được; \q chúng chẳng được vui gì từ lợi nhuận buôn bán của mình.
vi.R: Chúng sẽ phải trả lại những gì mình làm ra trước khi kịp hưởng. \q Tiền bạc chúng kiếm được sẽ chẳng làm chúng vui chút nào.

ko.L: [그는] 수고의 [열매]를 돌려주고 [그것을] 삼키지 못하며, \q 그가 장사하여 얻은 재물로 기뻐하지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 애써 얻은 것을 돌려주어야 하고 삼키지 못하며, \q 장사로 얻은 이익에서 아무 기쁨도 얻지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 일해서 얻은 것을 누리기도 전에 돌려주어야 할 것이다. \q 벌어들인 돈이 그들에게 아무 즐거움도 주지 못할 것이다.

decisions.choice: fruit of toil: what he gained by labor
decisions.reason: Yaga' occurs only here; it comes from the verb "to toil" and means what toil has earned.

decisions.choice: the wealth of his trading: the profit of his business
alternatives: as great as his wealth, so great the restitution he must make
decisions.reason: Temurah is exchange or trade (28:17; Ruth 4:7). The line most likely means he will not enjoy the profit he made. It can also be read as "according to the wealth of his exchange": he must give back as much as he gained.

decisions.choice: give back ... not swallow: verses 10 and 15 again
decisions.reason: "Give back" repeats verse 10 and "swallow" verse 15: what he took he must return before he can enjoy it.

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

source.text: כִּֽי־רִ֭צַּץ עָזַ֣ב דַּלִּ֑ים בַּ֥יִת גָּ֝זַ֗ל וְלֹ֣א יִבֶנֵֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For he crushed, he abandoned [the] poor; a house he seized and he will not build it.

en.L: For he crushed [and] abandoned [the] poor; \q he seized a house that he did not build.
en.B: For they crushed the poor and left them destitute; \q they seized houses they had not built.
en.R: This is because they crushed poor people and left them with nothing. \q They took houses that they had not built.

es.L: Porque aplastó [y] abandonó a [los] pobres; \q se apoderó de una casa que no edificó.
es.B: Porque aplastaron a los pobres y los dejaron en la miseria; \q se apoderaron de casas que no habían construido.
es.R: Esto es porque aplastaron a los pobres y los dejaron sin nada. \q Se quedaron con casas que ellos no habían construido.

fr.L: Car il a écrasé [et] abandonné [les] pauvres ; \q il s’est emparé d’une maison qu’il n’a pas bâtie.
fr.B: Car ils ont écrasé les pauvres et les ont laissés dans le dénuement ; \q ils se sont emparés de maisons qu’ils n’avaient pas bâties.
fr.R: C’est parce qu’ils ont écrasé les pauvres et les ont laissés sans rien. \q Ils ont pris des maisons qu’ils n’avaient pas construites.

sw.L: Kwa maana aliwaponda [na] kuwaacha maskini; \q alinyakua nyumba ambayo hakuijenga.
sw.B: Kwa maana waliwaonea maskini na kuwaacha hohehahe; \q walinyakua nyumba ambazo hawakuzijenga.
sw.R: Hii ni kwa sababu waliwakandamiza maskini na kuwaacha bila kitu. \q Walichukua nyumba ambazo hawakuzijenga.

vi.L: Vì hắn đã chà đạp [và] bỏ mặc [người] nghèo; \q hắn đã chiếm đoạt một ngôi nhà mà hắn không xây.
vi.B: Vì chúng đã chà đạp người nghèo và bỏ mặc họ trắng tay; \q chúng đã chiếm đoạt những ngôi nhà mình không hề xây.
vi.R: Đó là vì chúng đã đè bẹp người nghèo và để họ không còn gì cả. \q Chúng đã cướp những ngôi nhà mà chúng không xây.

ko.L: 이는 그가 가난한 자들을 짓밟고 버렸기 때문이다. \q 그는 자기가 짓지 않은 집을 빼앗았다.
ko.B: 그들이 가난한 사람들을 짓밟고 빈털터리로 버려두었기 때문이다. \q 그들은 자기가 짓지 않은 집들을 빼앗았다.
ko.R: 그것은 그들이 가난한 사람들을 짓밟아 아무것도 없이 버려두었기 때문이다. \q 그들은 자기가 짓지도 않은 집들을 빼앗았다.

decisions.choice: for: the reason for his downfall
decisions.reason: "For" gives the reason for verses 15-18: he must give back what he took because he took it from the poor.

decisions.choice: crushed and abandoned: oppressed and left helpless
decisions.reason: Ritstsets is to crush or oppress (Amos 4:1; 1 Samuel 12:3-4); 'azav is to forsake. He ground down the poor and then left them to their fate.

decisions.choice: that he did not build
alternatives: and he will not get to build it up
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "and he will not build it". It most likely means a house built by others, which he simply took (compare Deuteronomy 6:10-11). It may also mean that he will not live to rebuild or enjoy the house he seized.

decisions.choice: This is because
decisions.reason: Readable makes the link to the verses before plain (m1).

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

source.text: כִּ֤י׀לֹא־יָדַ֣ע שָׁלֵ֣ו בְּבִטְנ֑וֹ בַּ֝חֲמוּד֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: For he did not know ease in his belly; with his desired [things] he will not escape.

en.L: For he knew no quiet in his belly; \q with what he desired he will not escape.
en.B: Because their greed was never satisfied, \q they will not save any of the things they prized.
en.R: Their stomach was never satisfied; they always wanted more. \q So they will not be able to keep any of the things they loved.

es.L: Porque no conoció sosiego en su vientre; \q con lo que codiciaba no escapará.
es.B: Porque su codicia nunca se sació, \q no salvarán nada de lo que tanto apreciaban.
es.R: Su estómago nunca se llenaba; siempre querían más. \q Por eso no podrán quedarse con nada de lo que amaban.

fr.L: Car il n’a pas connu de repos dans son ventre ; \q avec ce qu’il convoitait, il n’échappera pas.
fr.B: Parce que leur avidité n’a jamais été rassasiée, \q ils ne sauveront rien de ce à quoi ils tenaient.
fr.R: Leur ventre n’était jamais rassasié ; ils voulaient toujours plus. \q Alors ils ne pourront rien garder de ce qu’ils aimaient.

sw.L: Kwa maana hakujua utulivu tumboni mwake; \q pamoja na alivyovitamani hataokoka.
sw.B: Kwa sababu tamaa yao haikutosheka kamwe, \q hawataokoa chochote kati ya vitu walivyovithamini.
sw.R: Matumbo yao hayakutosheka kamwe; walitaka zaidi siku zote. \q Kwa hiyo hawataweza kubaki na chochote walichokipenda.

vi.L: Vì hắn chẳng biết yên ổn trong bụng mình; \q với những gì hắn thèm muốn, hắn sẽ không thoát được.
vi.B: Vì lòng tham của chúng chẳng bao giờ thỏa mãn, \q chúng sẽ chẳng cứu được gì trong những thứ mình quý chuộng.
vi.R: Bụng chúng chẳng bao giờ no; chúng luôn muốn thêm nữa. \q Vì vậy chúng sẽ không giữ được gì trong những thứ mình yêu thích.

ko.L: 이는 그가 그의 배 속에 평온을 알지 못했기 때문이니, \q 그가 탐내던 것을 가지고 피하지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들의 탐욕은 한 번도 채워진 적이 없었으니, \q 그들이 아끼던 것을 하나도 건지지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 그들의 배는 한 번도 만족한 적이 없었다. 늘 더 가지려고 했다. \q 그래서 그들이 좋아하던 것을 하나도 지키지 못할 것이다.

decisions.choice: knew no quiet in his belly: his greed never rested
decisions.reason: The belly is the seat of appetite. Shalev means at ease or quiet. His craving was never at rest.

decisions.choice: he will not save anything he treasured
alternatives: his greed let nothing escape it
decisions.reason: The verb (millet) means to let escape or to save. The line most likely means that none of his treasures will save him or be saved. It may also look back to the first line: in his greed he let nothing escape him.

decisions.choice: greed
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the belly stands for (m1); Literal and Readable keep the picture.

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

source.text: אֵין־שָׂרִ֥יד לְאָכְל֑וֹ עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן לֹא־יָחִ֥יל טוּבֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: There [is] no survivor to his eating; therefore his prosperity will not endure.

en.L: Nothing escaped his devouring; \q therefore his prosperity will not last.
en.B: Nothing was left after they had eaten; \q therefore their prosperity will not last.
en.R: They devoured everything and left nothing for anyone else. \q That is why their good times will not last.

es.L: Nada escapó a su voracidad; \q por eso su prosperidad no durará.
es.B: Nada quedaba después de que comían; \q por eso su prosperidad no durará.
es.R: Lo devoraban todo y no dejaban nada para nadie. \q Por eso sus buenos tiempos no durarán.

fr.L: Rien n’a échappé à sa voracité ; \q c’est pourquoi sa prospérité ne durera pas.
fr.B: Rien ne restait après qu’ils avaient mangé ; \q c’est pourquoi leur prospérité ne durera pas.
fr.R: Ils ont tout dévoré sans rien laisser aux autres. \q Voilà pourquoi leurs beaux jours ne dureront pas.

sw.L: Hakuna kilichosalia katika ulaji wake; \q kwa hiyo fanaka yake haitadumu.
sw.B: Hakuna kilichobaki baada ya wao kula; \q kwa hiyo fanaka yao haitadumu.
sw.R: Walikula kila kitu, wasimwachie mtu yeyote kitu. \q Ndiyo sababu siku zao nzuri hazitadumu.

vi.L: Chẳng gì thoát khỏi sự ăn nuốt của hắn; \q vì thế sự thịnh vượng của hắn sẽ không bền lâu.
vi.B: Chúng ăn rồi thì chẳng còn sót lại gì; \q vì thế sự thịnh vượng của chúng sẽ không bền lâu.
vi.R: Chúng nuốt sạch mọi thứ, chẳng chừa lại gì cho ai. \q Vì vậy những ngày sung sướng của chúng sẽ chẳng kéo dài.

ko.L: 그가 먹어 치우는 데서 남은 것이 없었으니, \q 그러므로 그의 번영은 오래가지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들이 먹고 나면 남는 것이 없었으니, \q 그러므로 그들의 번영은 오래가지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 모든 것을 먹어 치우고 남에게 아무것도 남겨 두지 않았다. \q 그래서 그들의 좋은 시절은 오래가지 못할 것이다.

decisions.choice: survivor: what is left, a remnant
decisions.reason: Sarid is a survivor, someone or something left (18:19). His greed left nothing behind.

decisions.choice: therefore: the punishment fits the wrong
decisions.reason: Because he devoured everything, his own good fortune will be devoured. The same word sarid comes back in 20:26: nothing will be left of him either.

decisions.choice: prosperity: his good things
decisions.reason: Tuv is goodness, here good fortune and wealth (21:16).

decisions.choice: left nothing for anyone else
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the picture means (m1).

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

source.text: בִּמְלֹ֣אות שִׂ֭פְקוֹ יֵ֣צֶר ל֑וֹ כָּל־יַ֖ד עָמֵ֣ל תְּבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: In the fullness of his plenty it will be distress to him; every hand of a sufferer will come on him.

en.L: In the fullness of his plenty, distress will come to him; \q every hand of [the] wretched will come against him.
en.B: At the height of their plenty, distress will overtake them; \q every hand of the wretched will turn against them.
en.R: Just when they have more than enough, trouble will catch them, \q and all the people they made miserable will attack them.

es.L: En la plenitud de su abundancia le vendrá angustia; \q toda mano de [los] desdichados vendrá contra él.
es.B: En la cumbre de su abundancia, la angustia los alcanzará; \q toda mano de los desdichados se volverá contra ellos.
es.R: Justo cuando tengan más que suficiente, les caerá la desgracia, \q y todos los que ellos hicieron sufrir los atacarán.

fr.L: Dans la plénitude de son abondance, la détresse lui viendra ; \q toute main des malheureux viendra contre lui.
fr.B: Au comble de leur abondance, la détresse les saisira ; \q toutes les mains des malheureux se tourneront contre eux.
fr.R: Au moment même où ils auront plus qu’assez, le malheur les rattrapera, \q et tous ceux qu’ils ont rendus malheureux les attaqueront.

sw.L: Katika ukamilifu wa wingi wake, dhiki itamjia; \q kila mkono wa wanyonge utakuja juu yake.
sw.B: Katika kilele cha wingi wao, dhiki itawapata; \q kila mkono wa wanyonge utageuka dhidi yao.
sw.R: Wakati ule ule walipo na zaidi ya kutosha, taabu itawakamata, \q na watu wote waliowatesa watawashambulia.

vi.L: Trong lúc sung túc tràn đầy, sự khốn quẫn sẽ đến với hắn; \q mọi bàn tay của [kẻ] khốn khổ sẽ đến nghịch cùng hắn.
vi.B: Đang lúc dư dật nhất, cơn khốn quẫn sẽ ập đến trên chúng; \q mọi bàn tay của người khốn khổ sẽ quay lại chống chúng.
vi.R: Ngay khi chúng có dư thừa, tai họa sẽ bắt kịp chúng, \q và tất cả những người bị chúng làm cho khốn khổ sẽ tấn công chúng.

ko.L: 그의 풍족함이 가득할 때에 곤경이 그에게 닥치고, \q 비참한 자들의 모든 손이 그를 칠 것이다.
ko.B: 그들의 풍요가 절정에 이를 때 곤경이 그들을 덮치고, \q 비참한 사람들의 모든 손이 그들을 대적할 것이다.
ko.R: 넉넉하고도 남을 바로 그때 재앙이 그들을 따라잡고, \q 그들이 괴롭힌 사람들이 모두 그들을 공격할 것이다.

decisions.choice: plenty: having more than enough
decisions.reason: Sefeq occurs only here and means sufficiency or abundance.

decisions.choice: distress: being hemmed in
decisions.reason: The verb (tsarar) means to be narrow or in straits. Even with plenty he will be trapped.

decisions.choice: every hand of the wretched: the people he made to suffer will strike back
alternatives: the full force of misery will come on him
decisions.reason: 'Amel, as the text is pointed, is a person who suffers; their hands turn against him. With a different vowel it is "trouble", and the line would mean that every blow of trouble comes on him.

decisions.choice: the people they made miserable
decisions.reason: Readable links the sufferers with the poor of verse 19, which the reading in m3 implies.

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

source.text: יְהִ֤י׀לְמַלֵּ֬א בִטְנ֗וֹ יְֽשַׁלַּח־בּ֭וֹחֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑וֹ וְיַמְטֵ֥ר עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ בִּלְחוּמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let it be: to fill his belly, he will send on him the burning of his anger, and he will rain on him in his flesh.

en.L: When he is about to fill his belly, \q [God] will send the burning of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger on him \q and will rain [it] on him as his food.
en.B: When they are about to fill their stomach, \q God will send {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} burning anger against them \q and rain it down on them as their food.
en.R: Just when they are about to fill their stomach, \q God will send {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} burning anger against them, \q raining it down on them like food.

es.L: Cuando esté por llenar su vientre, \q [Dios] enviará sobre él el ardor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira \q y [la] hará llover sobre él como su comida.
es.B: Cuando estén por llenarse el estómago, \q Dios enviará contra ellos el ardor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira \q y la hará llover sobre ellos como comida.
es.R: Justo cuando estén a punto de llenarse el estómago, \q Dios enviará contra ellos {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira ardiente, \q haciéndola llover sobre ellos como comida.

fr.L: Quand il sera sur le point de remplir son ventre, \q [Dieu] enverra contre lui l’ardeur de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère \q et [la] fera pleuvoir sur lui comme sa nourriture.
fr.B: Quand ils seront sur le point de se remplir l’estomac, \q Dieu enverra contre eux l’ardeur de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère \q et la fera pleuvoir sur eux comme nourriture.
fr.R: Juste au moment où ils vont se remplir l’estomac, \q Dieu enverra contre eux {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère brûlante, \q en la faisant pleuvoir sur eux comme de la nourriture.

sw.L: Atakapokuwa karibu kujaza tumbo lake, \q [Mungu] atampelekea ukali wa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} \q na kuinyesha juu yake kama chakula chake.
sw.B: Wanapokaribia kujaza matumbo yao, \q Mungu atawapelekea hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kali \q na kuinyesha juu yao kama chakula chao.
sw.R: Wakati ule ule wanapokaribia kujaza matumbo yao, \q Mungu atawapelekea hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kali, \q akiinyesha juu yao kama chakula.

vi.L: Khi hắn sắp làm đầy bụng mình, \q [Đức Chúa Trời] sẽ giáng trên hắn cơn giận nóng cháy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và đổ [nó] xuống như mưa trên hắn làm thức ăn của hắn.
vi.B: Khi chúng sắp ăn no bụng, \q Đức Chúa Trời sẽ giáng cơn giận nóng cháy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên chúng \q và đổ nó xuống như mưa trên chúng làm thức ăn.
vi.R: Ngay lúc chúng sắp ăn no nê, \q Đức Chúa Trời sẽ giáng cơn giận nóng cháy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên chúng, \q đổ xuống trên chúng như mưa, như thể đó là thức ăn.

ko.L: 그가 자기 배를 채우려 할 때에, \q [하나님께서] 그분의 맹렬한 진노를 그에게 보내시고, \q 그것을 그의 음식으로 그 위에 비처럼 내리실 것이다.
ko.B: 그들이 배를 채우려 할 바로 그때, \q 하나님께서 불타는 진노를 그들에게 보내시고, \q 그것을 그들의 음식으로 비처럼 쏟으실 것이다.
ko.R: 그들이 막 배를 채우려 할 때, \q 하나님께서 불같은 진노를 그들에게 보내시어, \q 음식처럼 그들 위에 비 오듯 쏟아부으실 것이다.

decisions.choice: let it be, to fill his belly: just when he is about to eat his fill
decisions.reason: "Let it be" with "to fill" sets the time: at the very moment he is about to fill himself.

decisions.choice: God is the one who sends: his anger
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject, but "his anger" can only be God's, whom Zophar named in verse 15 and names again in verse 29.

decisions.choice: as his food
decisions.reason: Lechum may be food (from the word for bread) or flesh (Zephaniah 1:17). As food, God's anger is the meal he gets instead of the one he wanted; as flesh, it falls on his body.

decisions.choice: rain on him: anger rained down like food from heaven
decisions.reason: God rained fire on Sodom (Genesis 19:24) and rained food on Israel in the desert; when they craved more, "while the food was still in their mouths, the anger of God rose against them" (Psalm 78:24-31).

decisions.choice: [God]
decisions.reason: Literal brackets the subject so that "he" is not taken for the wicked person (m2).

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God (m2).

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

decisions.choice: The deity_pronoun span stands on the possessive "yake" (hasira Yake)
decisions.reason: Swahili marks the pronoun for God inside the verbs ("atampelekea"), where it cannot take a capital; the free possessive is the one word the setting can change.

source.text: יִ֭בְרַח מִנֵּ֣שֶׁק בַּרְזֶ֑ל תַּ֝חְלְפֵ֗הוּ קֶ֣שֶׁת נְחוּשָֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: He will flee from a weapon of iron; a bow of bronze will pierce him.

en.L: He flees from a weapon of iron; \q a bow of bronze pierces him.
en.B: They may run from an iron weapon, \q but an arrow from a bronze bow will pierce them.
en.R: They may run away from an iron weapon, \q but an arrow from a bronze bow will hit them.

es.L: Huye del arma de hierro; \q el arco de bronce lo atraviesa.
es.B: Puede que huyan de un arma de hierro, \q pero una flecha de arco de bronce los traspasará.
es.R: Puede que escapen de un arma de hierro, \q pero una flecha de un arco de bronce los alcanzará.

fr.L: Il fuit devant une arme de fer ; \q un arc de bronze le transperce.
fr.B: Ils peuvent fuir devant une arme de fer, \q mais une flèche d’un arc de bronze les transpercera.
fr.R: Ils échapperont peut-être à une arme de fer, \q mais une flèche tirée d’un arc de bronze les atteindra.

sw.L: Anakimbia silaha ya chuma; \q upinde wa shaba unamchoma.
sw.B: Huenda wakaikimbia silaha ya chuma, \q lakini mshale wa upinde wa shaba utawachoma.
sw.R: Huenda wakaiepuka silaha ya chuma, \q lakini mshale kutoka upinde wa shaba utawapiga.

vi.L: Hắn chạy trốn khỏi vũ khí bằng sắt; \q cây cung bằng đồng đâm thủng hắn.
vi.B: Chúng có thể trốn khỏi vũ khí bằng sắt, \q nhưng mũi tên từ cung đồng sẽ đâm xuyên chúng.
vi.R: Chúng có thể chạy thoát khỏi vũ khí bằng sắt, \q nhưng mũi tên bắn từ cung đồng sẽ trúng chúng.

ko.L: 그가 쇠 무기를 피하여 도망하나, \q 놋 활이 그를 꿰뚫는다.
ko.B: 그들이 쇠 무기는 피해 달아날지 몰라도, \q 놋 활에서 날아온 화살이 그들을 꿰뚫을 것이다.
ko.R: 그들이 쇠 무기는 피할 수 있을지 몰라도, \q 놋 활에서 쏜 화살에 맞을 것이다.

decisions.choice: escaping one danger only to meet another
decisions.reason: He gets away from one weapon and is struck by another, a picture of a doom that cannot be escaped (Amos 5:19; Isaiah 24:18).

decisions.choice: a bow of bronze: an arrow shot from a strong bow
decisions.reason: The bow stands for its arrow. A bow of bronze is a bow fitted with bronze, the strongest kind (2 Samuel 22:35; Psalm 18:35).

decisions.choice: an arrow from a bronze bow
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "arrow", since it is the arrow that pierces (m2).

decisions.choice: may run ... but
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable show the contrast between the two lines (m1).

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

source.text: שָׁלַף֮ וַיֵּצֵ֪א מִגֵּ֫וָ֥ה וּ֭בָרָק מִֽמְּרֹרָת֥וֹ יַהֲלֹ֗ךְ עָלָ֥יו אֵמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: He draws [it] out, and it comes out from [the] back, and lightning from his gall goes; on him [are] terrors.

en.L: He draws [it] out, and it comes out of [his] back, \q and the gleaming [point] out of his gall; \q terrors [are] upon him.
en.B: It is pulled out and comes out of their back, \q the gleaming point out of their gall; \q terrors come over them.
en.R: The arrow is pulled out through their back; \q its shining tip comes out of their body. \q Terror takes hold of them.

es.L: La saca, y sale de [su] espalda, \q y la [punta] reluciente de su hiel; \q terrores [hay] sobre él.
es.B: Se la sacan y les sale por la espalda, \q la punta reluciente por la hiel; \q los terrores caen sobre ellos.
es.R: La flecha se les saca por la espalda; \q su punta brillante sale de su cuerpo. \q El terror se apodera de ellos.

fr.L: Il [la] retire, et elle sort de [son] dos, \q et la [pointe] étincelante de son fiel ; \q des terreurs [sont] sur lui.
fr.B: On la retire, elle sort de leur dos, \q la pointe étincelante sort de leur fiel ; \q des terreurs s’abattent sur eux.
fr.R: La flèche est arrachée par leur dos ; \q sa pointe brillante sort de leur corps. \q La terreur s’empare d’eux.

sw.L: Anauchomoa, nao unatoka mgongoni [mwake], \q na [ncha] inayong'aa kutoka nyongo yake; \q vitisho [viko] juu yake.
sw.B: Unachomolewa na kutoka mgongoni mwao, \q ncha inayong'aa ikitoka katika nyongo yao; \q vitisho vinawajia.
sw.R: Mshale unachomolewa kupitia migongo yao; \q ncha yake inayong'aa inatoka miilini mwao. \q Hofu kuu inawashika.

vi.L: Hắn rút [nó] ra, và nó ra khỏi lưng [hắn], \q và [mũi] sáng loáng ra khỏi túi mật hắn; \q những nỗi kinh hoàng [ở] trên hắn.
vi.B: Mũi tên bị rút ra, xuyên qua lưng chúng, \q mũi nhọn sáng loáng ra khỏi túi mật chúng; \q nỗi kinh hoàng phủ lên chúng.
vi.R: Mũi tên bị rút ra qua lưng chúng; \q đầu tên sáng loáng ló ra khỏi thân thể chúng. \q Nỗi kinh hoàng bao trùm lấy chúng.

ko.L: 그가 [그것을] 뽑으니 [그의] 등에서 나오고, \q 번쩍이는 [촉이] 그의 쓸개에서 나오며, \q 공포가 그에게 [임한다].
ko.B: 화살이 뽑혀 그들의 등으로 나오고, \q 번쩍이는 촉이 그들의 쓸개에서 나오니, \q 공포가 그들을 덮친다.
ko.R: 화살이 그들의 등을 뚫고 뽑혀 나오고, \q 번쩍이는 화살촉이 몸에서 빠져나오니, \q 두려움이 그들을 사로잡을 것이다.

decisions.choice: lightning: the flashing point of the arrow
decisions.reason: Baraq is lightning; here it is the gleaming tip of the weapon (Deuteronomy 32:41; Nahum 3:3).

decisions.choice: gall: the gall bladder, the seat of a deadly wound
decisions.reason: Merorah, the word used for venom in verse 14, is here the gall in the body, as in 16:13, where Job says God spilled his gall on the ground.

decisions.choice: he draws it out: someone draws the arrow out
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject. Either the wounded man or another pulls out the arrow; the point is that it has gone right through him.

decisions.choice: terrors: the terrors of death
decisions.reason: 'Emim are terrors. Bildad spoke of the terrors that chase the wicked and the king of terrors, death (18:11, 14).

decisions.choice: It is pulled out / The arrow is pulled out
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the passive, since who draws it out does not matter (m3).

decisions.choice: their body
decisions.reason: Readable says "body" so the reader is not stopped by the name of an organ.

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

decisions.choice: "fiel" for the gall
decisions.reason: "Fiel" is the gall (bile and the gall bladder) in the language of poetry and of the Bible, and keeps the link with "venin" in verse 14 through the bitter taste; "vésicule biliaire" is a medical term. Readable says "corps", as the English Readable says "body".

source.text: כָּל־חֹשֶׁךְ֮ טָמ֪וּן לִצְפּ֫וּנָ֥יו תְּ֭אָכְלֵהוּ אֵ֣שׁ לֹֽא־נֻפָּ֑ח יֵ֖רַע שָׂרִ֣יד בְּאָהֳלֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: All darkness [is] hidden for his treasured [things]; a fire not blown will consume him; it will go badly [for] a survivor in his tent.

en.L: All darkness [is] stored up for his treasures; \q a fire not fanned will consume him; \q it will go badly [for] the survivor in his tent.
en.B: Total darkness is stored up for their treasures. \q A fire no one fanned will consume them, \q and anyone left in their tent will come to harm.
en.R: Darkness is waiting for everything they stored up. \q A fire that no human lit will burn them up, \q and anyone left in their home will suffer.

es.L: Toda oscuridad [está] reservada para sus tesoros; \q un fuego no avivado lo consumirá; \q le irá mal [al] sobreviviente en su tienda.
es.B: Una oscuridad total está reservada para sus tesoros. \q Un fuego que nadie avivó los consumirá, \q y a cualquiera que quede en su tienda le irá mal.
es.R: La oscuridad aguarda a todo lo que acumularon. \q Un fuego que ningún ser humano encendió los quemará por completo, \q y el que quede en su casa sufrirá.

fr.L: Toutes les ténèbres [sont] réservées pour ses trésors ; \q un feu que nul n’a attisé le dévorera ; \q il ira mal [pour] le survivant dans sa tente.
fr.B: Des ténèbres totales sont réservées à leurs trésors. \q Un feu que personne n’a attisé les dévorera, \q et quiconque restera dans leur tente sera frappé de malheur.
fr.R: Les ténèbres attendent tout ce qu’ils ont amassé. \q Un feu qu’aucun humain n’a allumé les consumera, \q et ceux qui resteront dans leur maison souffriront.

sw.L: Giza lote [limewekwa] akiba kwa ajili ya hazina zake; \q moto usiopulizwa utamla; \q itakuwa vibaya [kwa] aliyesalia katika hema lake.
sw.B: Giza tupu limewekwa akiba kwa ajili ya hazina zao. \q Moto usiopulizwa na mtu utawateketeza, \q na yeyote atakayebaki katika hema lao atapatwa na mabaya.
sw.R: Giza linangoja kila kitu walichojiwekea akiba. \q Moto usiowashwa na mwanadamu utawateketeza, \q na yeyote atakayebaki nyumbani mwao atateseka.

vi.L: Mọi bóng tối [được] để dành cho kho báu của hắn; \q một ngọn lửa không ai thổi sẽ thiêu nuốt hắn; \q [kẻ] sót lại trong lều hắn sẽ gặp điều dữ.
vi.B: Bóng tối dày đặc đã dành sẵn cho kho báu của chúng. \q Ngọn lửa không ai thổi sẽ thiêu đốt chúng, \q và bất cứ ai còn sót lại trong lều chúng cũng sẽ gặp họa.
vi.R: Bóng tối đang chờ đợi mọi thứ chúng tích trữ. \q Ngọn lửa không do bàn tay con người nhóm lên sẽ thiêu rụi chúng, \q và ai còn lại trong nhà chúng cũng sẽ khổ sở.

ko.L: 온갖 어둠이 그의 보물들을 위해 감추어져 [있고], \q 부채질하지 않은 불이 그를 삼키며, \q 그의 장막에 남은 자가 화를 당할 것이다.
ko.B: 칠흑 같은 어둠이 그들의 보물을 위해 쌓여 있다. \q 아무도 부채질하지 않은 불이 그들을 삼키고, \q 그들의 장막에 남은 사람은 누구든 해를 입을 것이다.
ko.R: 그들이 쌓아 둔 모든 것을 어둠이 기다리고 있다. \q 사람이 붙이지 않은 불이 그들을 태워 버리고, \q 그들의 집에 남은 사람도 고통을 당할 것이다.

decisions.choice: darkness stored up for his treasures: disaster kept in store instead of riches
decisions.reason: "Hidden" (tamun) and "treasures" (tsefunim, things hidden away) are a play on words: what is kept in store for his hoard is darkness, that is, ruin.

decisions.choice: a fire not fanned: a fire no human hand lit
decisions.reason: A fire that no one blew on is a fire from God, like "the fire of God" that fell on Job's flocks (1:16).

decisions.choice: it will go badly for the survivor
alternatives: it will consume what is left in his tent
decisions.reason: The verb is taken here from ra'a', "to be bad": whoever is left in his tent will fare badly. With different vowels it is ra'ah, "to graze": the fire will eat up what is left. Both say nothing of his will remain.

decisions.choice: no human lit
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m2).

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

source.text: יְגַלּ֣וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם עֲוֺנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֶ֗רֶץ מִתְקוֹמָ֘מָ֥ה לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] heavens will reveal his iniquity, and [the] earth [will] rise up against him.

en.L: [The] heavens will reveal his iniquity, \q and [the] earth will rise up against him.
en.B: The heavens will expose their guilt, \q and the earth will rise up against them.
en.R: Heaven will show everyone the wrong they have done, \q and the earth will stand up to accuse them.

es.L: [Los] cielos revelarán su iniquidad, \q y [la] tierra se levantará contra él.
es.B: Los cielos pondrán al descubierto su culpa, \q y la tierra se levantará contra ellos.
