es.R: El cielo mostrará a todos el mal que hicieron, \q y la tierra se pondrá de pie para acusarlos.

fr.L: [Les] cieux révéleront son iniquité, \q et [la] terre se dressera contre lui.
fr.B: Les cieux mettront à nu leur faute, \q et la terre se dressera contre eux.
fr.R: Le ciel montrera à tous le mal qu’ils ont fait, \q et la terre se lèvera pour les accuser.

sw.L: Mbingu zitaufunua uovu wake, \q na nchi itainuka dhidi yake.
sw.B: Mbingu zitaifichua hatia yao, \q na dunia itainuka dhidi yao.
sw.R: Mbingu zitawaonyesha watu wote mabaya waliyoyatenda, \q na dunia itasimama kuwashtaki.

vi.L: [Các] tầng trời sẽ bày tỏ tội ác hắn, \q và đất sẽ dấy lên chống lại hắn.
vi.B: Các tầng trời sẽ phơi bày tội lỗi chúng, \q và đất sẽ nổi dậy chống lại chúng.
vi.R: Trời sẽ cho mọi người thấy điều ác chúng đã làm, \q và đất sẽ đứng lên tố cáo chúng.

ko.L: 하늘이 그의 죄악을 드러내고, \q 땅이 그를 대적하여 일어날 것이다.
ko.B: 하늘이 그들의 죄를 드러내고, \q 땅이 일어나 그들을 대적할 것이다.
ko.R: 하늘이 그들이 저지른 악을 모두에게 보여 주고, \q 땅이 일어나 그들을 고발할 것이다.

decisions.choice: heavens and earth as witnesses
decisions.reason: Heaven and earth are called as witnesses in court (Deuteronomy 32:1; Isaiah 1:2). Job had cried, "Earth, do not cover my blood", and said his witness was in heaven (16:18-19). Zophar turns this round: heaven and earth will testify against the wicked.

decisions.choice: iniquity: guilt
decisions.reason: 'Avon is wrongdoing and the guilt it brings (7:21; 10:6).

decisions.choice: stand up to accuse them
decisions.reason: Readable makes the court picture plain (m1).

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

source.text: יִ֭גֶל יְב֣וּל בֵּית֑וֹ נִ֝גָּר֗וֹת בְּי֣וֹם אַפּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: The produce of his house will go away, flowing away on the day of his anger.

en.L: The produce of his house will be carried off, \q flowing away on the day of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger.
en.B: The wealth of their house will be carried away, \q swept off like floodwaters on the day of God's anger.
en.R: Everything in their house will be carried away, \q swept off like a flood on the day God shows {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger.

es.L: El producto de su casa será llevado, \q derramándose en el día de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira.
es.B: La riqueza de su casa será arrastrada, \q barrida como por una crecida en el día de la ira de Dios.
es.R: Todo lo que hay en su casa será arrastrado, \q barrido como por una inundación el día en que Dios muestre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira.

fr.L: Les récoltes de sa maison seront emportées, \q s’écoulant au jour de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère.
fr.B: La richesse de leur maison sera emportée, \q balayée comme par une crue au jour de la colère de Dieu.
fr.R: Tout ce qu’il y a dans leur maison sera emporté, \q balayé comme par une inondation le jour où Dieu montrera {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère.

sw.L: Mazao ya nyumba yake yatachukuliwa, \q yakitiririka mbali siku ya hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Mali ya nyumba yao itachukuliwa, \q itafagiliwa kama na mafuriko siku ya hasira ya Mungu.
sw.R: Kila kitu kilichomo nyumbani mwao kitachukuliwa, \q kitafagiliwa kama na mafuriko siku ile Mungu atakapoonyesha hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Hoa lợi trong nhà hắn sẽ bị cuốn đi, \q trôi tuột đi trong ngày cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Của cải trong nhà chúng sẽ bị cuốn mất, \q bị quét sạch như nước lũ trong ngày Đức Chúa Trời nổi giận.
vi.R: Mọi thứ trong nhà chúng sẽ bị cuốn đi, \q bị quét sạch như cơn lũ trong ngày Đức Chúa Trời bày tỏ cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그의 집의 소산이 떠내려가고, \q 그분의 진노의 날에 물처럼 쏟아져 흘러가 버릴 것이다.
ko.B: 그들의 집의 재산은 휩쓸려 가고, \q 하나님께서 진노하시는 날에 홍수처럼 떠내려갈 것이다.
ko.R: 그들의 집에 있는 모든 것이 휩쓸려 가고, \q 하나님께서 진노를 나타내시는 날에 홍수에 떠내려가듯 사라질 것이다.

decisions.choice: the produce of his house will be carried off
alternatives: a flood will carry off his house
decisions.reason: Yevul is produce or harvest, here all that his house holds. The verb (galah) means to go away or into exile. A related word, yuval, means a stream (Jeremiah 17:8); read that way, the line says a flood will carry off his house. The sense is close.

decisions.choice: flowing away: poured out like water
decisions.reason: The word (niggarot) is used of water spilled on the ground that cannot be gathered up again (2 Samuel 14:14).

decisions.choice: his anger: God's
decisions.reason: The anger is God's, as in verse 23.

decisions.choice: God's anger / the day God shows his anger
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God (m3), since "his" in this speech usually means the wicked person.

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14).

source.text: זֶ֤ה׀חֵֽלֶק־אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְנַחֲלַ֖ת אִמְר֣וֹ מֵאֵֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: This [is] the portion of a wicked person from God, and the inheritance of his word from God.

en.L: This [is] the portion of a wicked {{gender:person|man}} from God, \q and the heritage decreed for him by God.
en.B: This is what God gives to the wicked, \q the heritage God has appointed for them.
en.R: This is what God has in store for wicked people. \q This is what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has decided they will receive.

es.L: Esta [es] la porción de {{gender:la persona malvada|el hombre malvado}} de parte de Dios, \q y la heredad que Dios le ha decretado.
es.B: Esto es lo que Dios da a los malvados, \q la herencia que Dios les ha asignado.
es.R: Esto es lo que Dios tiene reservado para los malvados. \q Esto es lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha decidido que reciban.

fr.L: Telle [est] la part {{gender:de l’être humain méchant|de l’homme méchant}} [venant] de Dieu, \q et l’héritage que Dieu lui a décrété.
fr.B: Voilà ce que Dieu donne aux méchants, \q l’héritage que Dieu leur a assigné.
fr.R: Voilà ce que Dieu réserve aux méchants. \q Voilà ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a décidé de leur donner.

sw.L: Hili [ndilo] fungu la mtu mwovu kutoka kwa Mungu, \q na urithi aliokatiwa na Mungu.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo Mungu anavyowapa waovu, \q urithi ambao Mungu amewawekea.
sw.R: Hiki ndicho Mungu alichowawekea watu waovu. \q Hiki ndicho alichoamua kwamba watapokea.

vi.L: Đây [là] phần của kẻ ác từ Đức Chúa Trời, \q và cơ nghiệp Đức Chúa Trời đã định cho hắn.
vi.B: Đây là phần Đức Chúa Trời ban cho kẻ ác, \q là cơ nghiệp Đức Chúa Trời đã định cho chúng.
vi.R: Đây là điều Đức Chúa Trời dành sẵn cho kẻ ác. \q Đây là những gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã định cho chúng phải nhận.

ko.L: 이것이 악한 사람이 하나님께 받을 몫이요, \q 하나님께서 그에게 정하신 유업이다.
ko.B: 이것이 하나님께서 악인들에게 주시는 몫이요, \q 하나님께서 그들에게 정하신 유업이다.
ko.R: 이것이 하나님께서 악한 사람들을 위해 마련해 두신 것이다. \q 그들이 받도록 그분께서 정하신 것이 바로 이것이다.

decisions.choice: portion and heritage: what one is allotted
decisions.reason: Cheleq (portion) and nachalah (inheritance) are words for a share of land (Numbers 18:20; Joshua 19:9). Zophar uses them with grim irony: the wicked person's inheritance from God is ruin. Bildad ends his speech the same way (18:21), and Job uses nearly the same words in 27:13.

decisions.choice: his word: the decree concerning him
decisions.reason: 'Emer is a word or saying. "The heritage of his word" most likely means the share decreed for him; it may also mean the share given by God's word. The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: God: 'Elohim and 'El
decisions.reason: Both lines name God, with two words ('Elohim, then 'El). Zophar's speech ends where it is meant to lead: God is the one who brings the wicked to ruin.

decisions.choice: a wicked person / man
decisions.reason: 'Adam is a human being, man or woman; Literal uses the gender setting.

decisions.choice: they / them / their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew singular means any wicked person (20:5, 29). Balanced and Readable use "they", which keeps the general sense; Literal follows the Hebrew "he" (as 8:14). Here Balanced and Readable say "the wicked" and "wicked people".

decisions.choice: gender span "la persona malvada" / "el hombre malvado"
decisions.reason: 'Adam is a human being, man or woman; Spanish has the two wordings, so the noun with its agreeing adjective takes the span.

decisions.choice: gender span on the noun phrase: "de l'être humain méchant" / "de l'homme méchant"
decisions.reason: 'Adam is a human being, man or woman; French puts the setting on the noun, with its adjective inside the span, as the French rules do.
